## Summary
Build the daily StudyQueue generation Inngest cron job that uses Pimsleur decay scheduling combined with BKT mastery levels and clinical tier priority to generate a personalized daily study queue for each student.

## User story
As a student, I want a daily study queue that prioritizes my most urgent review items using spaced repetition, so that I retain knowledge efficiently without manually tracking what needs review.

## Why this matters
Without spaced repetition, students either over-study mastered concepts or forget critical ones. The Pimsleur decay model ensures concepts are reviewed at the optimal moment before forgetting. Clinical tier weighting ensures life-critical concepts (Tier 1) are reviewed more aggressively.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Inngest cron fires daily at 8am: `"cron": "0 8 * * *"`
- [ ] Queue considers Pimsleur intervals: [1, 3, 7, 14, 30, 60, 120, Infinity] days
- [ ] Decay constant is 0.05 standard, 0.10 for clinical Tier 1 concepts
- [ ] Concepts with review_count < 3 excluded (BKT unreliable)
- [ ] Priority sorted by: clinical_tier ASC, -p_mastery ASC, review_due_ms ASC
- [ ] Queue capped at 30 items per student per day
- [ ] GET /api/practice/queue returns today's study queue for authenticated student
- [ ] Queue items include: concept name, p_mastery, days since last review, clinical tier
- [ ] Queue stored in study_queue table (regenerated daily, old entries purged)
- [ ] Emits journey/studyqueue.generate event on completion

## Inngest event context
Function: journey/cron-studyqueue
Trigger: `"cron": "0 8 * * *"` (daily at 8am)
Step 1: step.run('fetch-active-students', ...) — get all students with concept_mastery data
Step 2: step.run('generate-queues', ...) — Promise.allSettled across students
  - For each student: calculate decay, sort by priority, cap at 30, upsert to study_queue
Step 3: step.run('purge-old-queues', ...) — delete study_queue entries older than 7 days
Emits: journey/studyqueue.generate { student_count, total_items }
onFailure: Log to dead letter queue, retry next day (stale queue is acceptable)

## Code patterns to follow
```typescript
// features/mastery-tracking/services/StudyQueueService.ts
export const REVIEW_INTERVALS = [1, 3, 7, 14, 30, 60, 120, Infinity] as const;
export const DECAY_CONSTANT_STANDARD = 0.05;
export const DECAY_CONSTANT_TIER1 = 0.10;
export const MAX_QUEUE_SIZE = 30;
export const MIN_REVIEW_COUNT = 3; // Corbett & Anderson: BKT unreliable below 3

/** Ebbinghaus retention: R = e^(-t * decay_constant) */
export function calculateRetention(
  daysSinceReview: number,
  decayConstant: number
): number {
  return Math.exp(-daysSinceReview * decayConstant);
}

/** Get next Pimsleur interval based on current review count */
export function getPimsleurInterval(reviewCount: number): number {
  const index = Math.min(reviewCount, REVIEW_INTERVALS.length - 1);
  return REVIEW_INTERVALS[index];
}

/** Priority: lower = more urgent. clinical_tier ASC, -p_mastery, review urgency */
export function calculatePriority(
  clinicalTier: number,
  pMastery: number,
  daysSinceReview: number,
  pimsleurInterval: number
): number {
  const urgency = daysSinceReview / pimsleurInterval; // >1 = overdue
  return clinicalTier * 100 + (1 - pMastery) * 10 + urgency;
}

    const students = await step.run('fetch-active-students', async () => {

    await step.run('generate-queues', async () => {

      await Promise.allSettled(
        students.map(s => generateStudentQueue(s.id))
```

## Code patterns to AVOID
```typescript
// ✗ AP-03: Promise.all for batch student queue generation
await Promise.all(students.map(s => generateQueue(s))); // BANNED
// ✓ Use: Promise.allSettled(students.map(s => generateQueue(s)));

// ✗ Concepts with < 3 reviews in queue (BKT unreliable)
const concepts = mastery.filter(m => m.p_mastery < 0.95); // Missing review_count check
// ✓ Use: mastery.filter(m => m.review_count >= MIN_REVIEW_COUNT && m.p_mastery < 0.95)

// ✗ Read-modify-write for queue updates
const queue = await supabase.from('study_queue').select().single();
queue.completed = true;
await supabase.from('study_queue').update(queue); // BANNED
// ✓ Use: atomic update via .update({ completed: true }).eq('id', queueId)
```

## Automated tests (Playwright — runs during /validate)
```typescript
// tests/E08/E08-S07.pipeline.test.ts
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';
import {
  calculateRetention,
  getPimsleurInterval,
  calculatePriority,
  REVIEW_INTERVALS,
  DECAY_CONSTANT_STANDARD,
  DECAY_CONSTANT_TIER1,
} from '../../features/mastery-tracking/services/StudyQueueService';

test('Retention decays exponentially with time', () => {
  const r1 = calculateRetention(1, DECAY_CONSTANT_STANDARD);
  const r7 = calculateRetention(7, DECAY_CONSTANT_STANDARD);
  const r30 = calculateRetention(30, DECAY_CONSTANT_STANDARD);
  expect(r1).toBeGreaterThan(r7);
  expect(r7).toBeGreaterThan(r30);
  expect(r1).toBeCloseTo(Math.exp(-0.05), 4);
});

test('Tier 1 decays faster than standard', () => {
  const standard = calculateRetention(7, DECAY_CONSTANT_STANDARD);
  const tier1 = calculateRetention(7, DECAY_CONSTANT_TIER1);
  expect(tier1).toBeLessThan(standard);
});

test('Pimsleur intervals follow canonical sequence', () => {
  expect(getPimsleurInterval(0)).toBe(1);
  expect(getPimsleurInterval(1)).toBe(3);
  expect(getPimsleurInterval(2)).toBe(7);
  expect(getPimsleurInterval(3)).toBe(14);
  expect(getPimsleurInterval(7)).toBe(Infinity);
});

test('Priority: Tier 1 concepts always higher priority than Tier 3', () => {
  const tier1 = calculatePriority(1, 0.5, 3, 7);
  const tier3 = calculatePriority(3, 0.5, 3, 7);
  expect(tier1).toBeLessThan(tier3); // lower = more urgent
});

test('Priority: lower mastery = higher priority', () => {
  const low = calculatePriority(2, 0.2, 3, 7);
  const high = calculatePriority(2, 0.8, 3, 7);
  expect(low).toBeGreaterThan(high); // (1 - pMastery) component
});

// tests/E08/E08-S07.api.test.ts
test('GET /api/practice/queue returns 401 without auth', async ({ request }) => {
  const res = await request.get('/api/practice/queue');
  expect(res.status()).toBe(401);
});

test('GET /api/practice/queue returns study queue for authenticated student', async ({ request }) => {
  const { token } = await getTestToken(request, 'student');
  const res = await request.get('/api/practice/queue', {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }
  });
  expect(res.status()).toBe(200);
  const { data } = await res.json();
  expect(data.queue_date).toBeDefined();
  expect(data.items).toBeDefined();
  expect(data.total_items).toBeLessThanOrEqual(30);
});
```
